summary:
Vaalnex presents COSMOS - Beyond the Known, an interactive 3D simulator of space missions and solar system exploration. Built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, COSMOS allows users to explore the Sun and all planets, from Mercury to Uranus, with real scientific data such as distance from the Sun, orbital period, rotation period, and number of moons.

Users can select a planet to focus the camera, pause orbits, view the full solar system, and simulate a mission with the "Launch to Mars" feature. Our goal is to make space science accessible, visual, and engaging for students and curious minds, especially in Angola and Africa, where access to planetariums and space education is limited. COSMOS turns complex astronomy into an intuitive journey, inspiring the next generation to explore, learn, and dream beyond Earth.
